

##### MENU (cmd 0 / boot) #####

============== ADBMS6830 COMMAND MENU ========================
-- Configuration ---------------------------------------------
   1  Write and Read Configuration        (writes)
   2  Read Configuration
  21  Write Configuration                 (writes)
  22  Read Device SID
-- Cell voltages ---------------------------------------------
   3  Start Cell Voltage Conversion
   4  Read Cell Voltages
   7  Start Avg Cell Voltage Conversion
   8  Read Avg Cell Voltages
   9  Start F-Cell Voltage Conversion
  10  Read F-Cell Voltages
   5  Start S-Voltage Conversion
   6  Read S-Voltages
-- Aux / temperature -----------------------------------------
  11  Start Aux Voltage Conversion
  12  Read Aux Voltages
  13  Start RAux Voltage Conversion
  14  Read RAux Voltages
-- Status ----------------------------------------------------
  15  Read Status Registers               (writes config)
-- Diagnostics -----------------------------------------------
  16  Loop Measurements                   (writes config)
  17  Clear Cell registers
  18  Clear Aux registers
  19  Clear Spin registers
  20  Clear Fcell registers
--------------------------------------------------------------
   0  Reprint this menu
Please enter command:
